newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen track yen, Nikkei in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen track yen, Nikkei in listless trade.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures spent Monday tracking moves in the dollar/yen and Nikkei markets in a dull, holiday-thinned market with many local players out for the Moslem New Year holiday.

Dealers said the yen's firmer tone against the dollar after a weekend Group of Seven (G7) nations meeting boosted Euroyen futures in early trade, but they failed to sustain the gains in the face of the Nikkei's unexpected rebound and the yen's slight drop later in the day.
A communique at the end of the G7 meeting called for currency stability and said that misalignments in exchange markets had been corrected since the last G7 statement in April 1995.
The dollar rose to 123.10 in late Asian trade, unchanged from its New York close, after falling as low as 120.30 earlier.

September Euroyen hit a new contract high of 99.39 in early trade but spent the rest of the day languishing in a two-tick range. It was quoted at 99.37 at 1130 GMT unchanged from its IMM close. December was at 99.26. Turnover for both months was a thin 5,305 and 2,910 lots respectively.
Dealers said further gains were checked by the Nikkei's unexpected rebound in the afternoon.
"Chartwise, most of the Euroyen contracts are pretty toppish. It's time to do some selling," said a trader with a U.S. house.
Dealers said the release of weaker-than-expected machinery orders data for December had little impact on the market.
Japanese government bond (JGB) futures for March ended at 126.36 against their previous 126.49, after hitting a high of 126.80.
Dealers said the contract's failure to climb above a previous contract high of 126.85 triggered long liquidations.
"Any dip in JGBs should be a buy because that's the main contract that gives Japanese pension funds and life insurers a return," said the trader.
Eurodollar futures were little moved in an even thinner market, with the September contract ending at 94.23 against its IMM close at 94.22 on volume of 1,810 lots.
